subject: Roland Barthes (1915–1980), French literary critic and semiotician. Author of the 1957 essay 'La Grande Famille des Hommes' in Mythologies — one of the foundational early critiques of The Family of Man as humanist universalism that naturalises social difference. Photo taken for Swedish newspaper Dagens Nyheter on 27 February 1969.
